Artist album and event preparation
milestones.implementationNotes: Revision-fenced show settings, private unplayed-track editing and browser metadata checks implemented; durable ingest and real-show preparation remain open.

milestones.title: Local album playback and show audio foundation
milestones.implementationNotes: Prepared device files persist in IndexedDB with SHA-256 verification; local album-order continuation releases live control and keeps generation paused. Offline console reload, hardware routing and rehearsal remain open.

Durable realtime subscriptions and recovery
milestones.implementationNotes: Existing durable event-log streaming and snapshot fallback now reject older arriving responses and disable audience voting while offline, stale or awaiting foreground refresh. Multi-instance fanout and venue/load acceptance remain open.

Release email push and preferences
milestones.implementationNotes: Opt-in verified event email, encrypted contacts, bounded durable outbox, unsubscribe, signed suppression callbacks and foreground web release notices implemented behind disabled delivery configuration. Real sender delivery, web/native push, large-crowd throughput and production migration remain open.

milestones.title: Performer feedback dashboard and Play next
milestones.implementationNotes: Reorder queued tracks with one-click Next, Up and Down; commands preserve current playback and reject stale queue state. Physical private-cue rehearsal remains open.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 21 of 42
Recording capture and recovery
milestones.implementationNotes: Chunked checksummed local recording now selects an exact browser input and stops on input disconnection. Synthetic browser coverage does not verify physical Rave/USB routing, long sessions or multitrack capture.

milestones.title: Production V1 — approved work package 23 of 42
Artist pages event archives and album commerce
milestones.implementationNotes: Editable public artist profile, HTTPS music links, filtered session archive, listener-first event links and album storefront links implemented. Room-code/remote-admission controls and native commerce review remain open.
